Interface CaptchaResolver

All Known Implementing Classes:
NullCaptchaResolver, SessionCaptchaResolver
public interface CaptchaResolver
Interface for captcha validation and storage implementations, supporting session-based or external captcha services.

      void setCaptcha(org.pac4j.core.context.WebContext context, org.pac4j.core.context.session.SessionStore sessionStore, String capText, Date capDate)
      Set the current captcha to the given one.
      Parameters:

      sessionStore - the session store
      capText - the new captcha value
      capDate - the captcha date
